arStrings.szText: "Seer Olyndra? Is that you? You look...older."
I am Olyndra still... only less of her than yesterday. Visions tax the body, and we who bear them are not meant for long lives.
Olyndra = oh-LIN-drah     OLYNDRA should sound older and frailer. She has rapidly aged a decade since last we saw her.
It was less drastic when we had the Sightless Eye, but such times are lost to us.
Longing for when the Oracles had a relic that did not make them age as rapidly.
